news.headline: US-Iran Tensions Drive WTI Crude Above $102 for 4th Consecutive Session
news.what_happened: WTI crude held at $102.73/bbl (+0.24%) with Brent at $107.86, sustained by escalating US-Iran military tensions. Fourth consecutive session above $100.
news.why_it_matters: Elevated crude directly widens India's current account deficit, fuels inflation and prompted RBI to cut FY27 GDP forecast to 6.6%. Airlines, paints, tyres and chemicals face severe input cost headwinds while upstream ONGC and OIL benefit directly from higher realisations.

news.headline: RBI Holds Rate at 5.25%, Cuts GDP Forecast to 6.6%, Raises Inflation Outlook to 5.1%
news.what_happened: RBI MPC held the repo rate at 5.25% but downgraded FY27 GDP growth from 6.9% to 6.6% citing oil price headwinds, monsoon disruption and weak global demand. Inflation forecast raised to 5.1%.
news.why_it_matters: Hawkish hold with a growth downgrade signals no near-term rate cuts. This is bearish for rate-sensitive sectors — banks, NBFCs, real estate — and dims FII appetite as India's growth premium narrows.

news.headline: US Markets Fall 4th Straight Day — S&P 500 -0.58%, Nasdaq -0.65%, 10Y Yield at 4.94%
news.what_happened: Dow fell 317 points, S&P 500 dropped to 7,591.70 (-0.58%) and Nasdaq to 26,081.72 (-0.65%). US 10-year yields spiked to 4.944%, highest in months, as $100+ oil stoked inflation fears.
news.why_it_matters: Four consecutive US declines plus rising yields signal broad risk-off. FII outflows from EMs including India are likely. Rising US yields compress Indian bank bond portfolios and remove pressure on RBI to cut rates.

news.headline: PSU Bank Strike Called for September 11 — Branch Operations May Be Disrupted
news.what_happened: Bank unions have called a nationwide strike on September 11. If materialised, branch-level services including cheque deposits, cash withdrawals and loan processing will be disrupted.
news.why_it_matters: Operational disruption adds negative sentiment on PSU bank stocks today. SBIN, BOB, CANARABANK and PNB may see intraday selling pressure on this overhang.

news.headline: Asia Broadly Weak: Nikkei -2.68%, Hang Seng -1.14% on Oil and China Demand Fears
news.what_happened: Nikkei 225 plunged 2.68% to 63,521 and Hang Seng fell 1.14% to 24,669 as elevated oil prices stoked inflation fears and China showed softness with slowing retail sales and muted industrial output.
news.why_it_matters: Broad Asian weakness and China demand concerns are bearish for Indian metal exporters and reinforce the risk-off mood. FIIs with pan-Asia mandates likely to trim India exposure.

picks.catalyst: WTI Crude above $102 for 4th consecutive session — US-Iran geopolitical tensions
picks.logic: ONGC produces ~850,000 bbl/day of crude. Every $1/bbl sustained rise adds ~Rs 900-1,000 Cr annual EBITDA. At $102.73 vs FY27 budget assumption of ~$75-80, earnings could be 15-20% above estimates. Oil & Gas sector was NSE top sectoral gainer yesterday. ONGC's direct P&L link to crude is the clearest catalyst in today's session.

picks.catalyst: WTI Crude above $102 — upstream realization directly tied to crude benchmark
picks.logic: Oil India is India's second-largest upstream producer with ~100,000 bbl/day output. Benefits directly from $100+ crude realization. OIL has lower FII ownership than ONGC and often lags ONGC's crude-driven move by 1-2 sessions, offering a catch-up opportunity. PSU upstream stocks also pay higher special dividends when realisations surge.
